content_sections.heading: VSSUT Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Junior Research Fellow/ Project Associate (Electrical & Electronics Engg), 1 for Junior Research Fellow/ Project Associate (Civil Engineering), 1 for Project Associate (Mechanical Engg) and 1 for Project Associate (Computer Sc and Engg).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of VSSUT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VSSUT recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the VSSUT Junior Research Fellow & Project Associate posts is 08-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow & Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow & Project Associate positions at Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology (VSSUT).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification includes B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.Sc/MCA in relevant engineering disciplines. GATE/NET qualification is preferred for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on the specific post and years of experience, as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for VSSUT recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview, as indicated in the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for VSSUT recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the VSSUT recruitment is scheduled to be held on 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this VSSUT recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q10. Which city and state is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology (VSSUT) located in Burla, Odisha.
